_comment: DRAFT (Story 14.4): the tavern's disturbances. Raphael rewrites the words; the numbers are placeholders to tune. GameManager rolls one a morning (game_config.json disturbance_*: below a reputation, a daily chance, a cooldown in days, and a schedule that forces one on a day: the demo's thief on Day 2). The hall's director (scripts/game/disturbance_director.gd) shows today's in the day phase: the visitor (body: a townsfolk variant id of data/characters/townsfolk.json, a placeholder body) stands at spot [x, z, yaw degrees] on the hall floor (picked in the code review, P2: 2.3 m from every E zone, 4.55 m from every patron seat: a waiting patron within 3 m of the player takes E) with the banner; E (prompt) opens his title of data/dialogue/disturbances.dialogue for the event's truth (truths: weights; one truth 'plain' for a type with no hidden truth). A reply that calls bridge.choose(id) decides it: outcomes[truth][id] = {rep, gold, line} (whole numbers; the line is the banner after). 'ignored' is the outcome when the day ends with the visitor still there. conditions.min_deaths: deaths this run needed (the mourner comes only after one).

thief.prompt: Press E - Talk to the stranger
thief.banner: A stranger lingers in the hall.

let_be.line: He slipped out. A patron's purse went with him.

ignored.line: He slipped out. A patron's purse went with him.

eject.line: He left angry. The room saw it.

let_be.line: His brother turned up at last.

ignored.line: His brother turned up at last.

rowdy_drunk.prompt: Press E - Talk to the drunk

let_be.line: He broke a tankard on his way out.

ignored.line: He broke a tankard on his way out.

grieving_family.prompt: Press E - Talk to the mourner
grieving_family.banner: Someone is waiting at the door.

pay.line: She left with the coin and her grief.

ignored.line: She waited all day, then left.

rival_guild_rep.prompt: Press E - Talk to the visitor
rival_guild_rep.banner: A man from another guild has walked in.

courteous.line: He tipped his hat on the way out.

drink.line: He drank, and left in good humour.

eject.line: He'll tell the town you're touchy.

ignored.line: He read your notices and left.
